lines.speaker: Expert
lines.text: Welcome to our clinical seminar. Today we discuss bronchiolitis, which is a common lower respiratory tract infection in infants, most often caused by respiratory syncytial virus.
lines.text_vi: Chào mừng đến với buổi hội thảo lâm sàng của chúng tôi.
lines.source_quote: Bronchiolitis is a common lower respiratory tract infection in infants, most often caused by respiratory syncytial virus

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.text: Thank you. What is the typical age of presentation, and how does the clinical picture usually unfold?
lines.text_vi: Cảm ơn chuyên gia. Độ tuổi điển hình khi biểu hiện bệnh là gì?

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.text: The typical age at presentation is under 12 months, with peak severity between 1 and 3 months of age. Caregivers usually report coryza followed by cough, fast breathing, and feeding difficulty.
lines.text_vi: Độ tuổi điển hình khi biểu hiện là dưới 12 tháng tuổi.
lines.source_quote: Typical age at presentation is under 12 months, with peak severity between 1 and 3 months of age

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.text: And regarding diagnostics, is routine chest radiography warranted for uncomplicated presentations?
lines.text_vi: Và về mặt chẩn đoán, có cần chụp X-quang ngực thường quy không?

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.text: Diagnosis is clinical; routine chest radiography and laboratory tests are not required for uncomplicated cases. Pulse oximetry helps guide oxygen therapy.
lines.text_vi: Chẩn đoán dựa trên lâm sàng; chụp X-quang ngực thường quy là không bắt buộc.
lines.source_quote: Diagnosis is clinical; routine chest radiography and laboratory tests are not required for uncomplicated cases

lines.speaker: Learner
lines.text: Understood. Should we routinely prescribe bronchodilators or corticosteroids for viral bronchiolitis?
lines.text_vi: Đã rõ. Chúng ta có nên thường xuyên kê đơn thuốc giãn phế quản không?

lines.speaker: Expert
lines.text: No, bronchodilators, corticosteroids, and antibiotics do not routinely improve outcomes in typical viral bronchiolitis. Supportive care remains the mainstay of management.
lines.text_vi: Không, thuốc giãn phế quản, corticosteroid và kháng sinh không cải thiện kết quả.
lines.source_quote: Bronchodilators, corticosteroids, and antibiotics do not routinely improve outcomes in typical viral bronchiolitis
